title: sprite.ts: shape visible=false ignored in colorEffectKey — visibility change across keyframes silently dropped
description:
File: packages/swf/src/sprite.ts, lines 484-496.

Bug: The colorEffectKey closure in encodeDefineSprite checks visible===false only for instance/text/bitmap types (line 487), and line 492 explicitly returns null for shapes. As a result, when a ShapeDisplayObject's visible changes between keyframes (e.g. visible=true on frame 1, visible=false on frame 5), the posChanged guard (line 521) never fires — the old colorEffectKey (null) matches the new key (null) even though rendering must change.

Compare with compile.ts lines 948-952 which correctly includes shape in the visible=false check for colorEffectKey.

Symptoms: A shape layer in a symbol that turns invisible partway through the timeline remains visible in the published SWF. Conversely, a shape that starts invisible and becomes visible never appears.

Fix: In the colorEffectKey computation in sprite.ts, add 'shape' to the visible=false check at line 487, mirroring the compile.ts implementation. Also include alpha and blendMode in the key for shape objects (compile.ts lines 956-967) so those changes also trigger posChanged.

Acceptance: Unit test asserting that a two-frame symbol with visible=true/false on a shape emits PlaceObject2 on frame 1 and a new PlaceObject2 (with zeroCXForm) on frame 2.
